attempts.title: Call withdraw() to pull funds out
attempts.how: The agent key calls the vault's owner-only withdraw method.
attempts.blockedBy: Refused by NEAR: the agent's key may only call execute(). NEAR said: "Access key does not allow method withdraw"

attempts.title: Transfer wNEAR straight from the token contract
attempts.how: The agent key signs ft_transfer on wrap.testnet to the attacker.
attempts.blockedBy: Refused by NEAR: the agent's key only works on the vault contract. NEAR said: "Access key receiver intentrail-vault4-39ae84.testnet does not match transaction receiver wrap.testnet"

attempts.title: Send NEAR to the attacker
attempts.how: The agent key signs a plain NEAR transfer out of the vault.
attempts.blockedBy: Refused by NEAR: sending tokens needs a full-access key, and the vault has none. NEAR said: "Access key requires full access"

attempts.title: Call execute() from another account with a valid quote
attempts.how: An outside account submits a genuine guard-signed quote. Only the agent key or the owner may execute.
attempts.blockedBy: Refused by the contract: Only the vault's agent key or the owner can execute trades

attempts.title: Edit a signed quote to move more
attempts.how: The guard signed a $1.50 trade; the agent raises the amount before sending it.
attempts.blockedBy: Contract check GUARD_SIGNATURE: Quote is not signed by the IntentRail guard key.

attempts.title: Steal the guard key and sign a $50 trade
attempts.how: A leak nobody has noticed yet: a validly signed quote, far above the $10 per-trade cap.
attempts.blockedBy: Contract check SIZE: $50 is over the $10 per-trade cap.

attempts.title: Steal the guard key and sell at half price
attempts.how: A validly signed swap whose minimum output is half the market rate.
attempts.blockedBy: Contract check PRICE_FLOOR: The quote's minimum output is below the owner's price floor for this pair.

attempts.title: Use the guard key the owner already rotated out
attempts.how: After the key-leak drill, quotes signed by the old key are worthless.
attempts.blockedBy: Contract check GUARD_SIGNATURE: Quote is not signed by the IntentRail guard key.

attempts.title: Replay the same signed quote
attempts.how: Send that exact quote and signature a second time.
attempts.blockedBy: Contract check QUOTE_REPLAY: Quote was already used.

attempts.title: Send a swap to the attacker's contract
attempts.how: A signed swap whose venue is an account the owner never approved.
attempts.blockedBy: Contract check VENUE: intentrail-attacker-39ae84.testnet is not an allowed venue.

attempts.title: Ask the pool for more than it can give
attempts.how: A swap whose minimum output is 2% above the pool price. The contract passes it on; Ref must refuse it and the vault gets its tokens back.
attempts.blockedBy: Refused at the venue. ref-finance-101.testnet said: "E68: slippage error". The vault was refunded and its daily spend restored.

attempts.title: An honest swap, for comparison
attempts.how: Sell 0.3 wNEAR for USDT on Ref Finance, within every limit. The agent needs nobody's permission.
attempts.blockedBy: Ref filled it: 0.3000 wNEAR for 0.3725 USDT, paid to the vault.
